Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1017
Claimant:
Laurie Gonzales
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
28 Nov 2023
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road and said the other vehicle drifted into tehir
lane as they were merging. They stated they were taken to hospital by ambulance with a head injury and were
diagnosed with a concussion.
21 Mar 2024
Reviewed the police report and the photos taken at the scene. The damage pattern along the driver's side is
consistent with the described impact, and the other driver's statement matches the claimant's account in its main
points.
1 Apr 2024
Spoke with the claimant by phone to confirm the sequence of events. They gave the same account as in the first
report and described the impact as a sharp jolt from the right that threw them against the side of the cabin.
7 Apr 2024
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses who saw the vehicles make contact as one was changing
lanes. Both described the same sequence and neither had any connection to the parties involved.
9 Apr 2024
Checked the claimant's medical records supplied with the claim. Tretament included imaging, a period of rest, and
follow-up appointments, and the notes show symptoms easing steadliy over several weeks. No earlier injury to the
same area appears in the records we hold.
8 May 2024
Confirmed with the claimant that the driver is named on the policy and that the vehicle was insured under this policy
at the time of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage, and no prior
damage to the vehicle is recorded.
17 May 2024
Noted that the claimant was not certain which seat position they occupied at the moment of impact, and recalled
being unsure wehther they had been seated toward the centre or the passenger side. This has been recorded as
stated and does not change the consistency of the rest of the account.
9 Jun 2024
Repair estimate has been received and its line items align with the damage seen in the photos and the reported
impact. Medical and vehicle findings are being progressed for settlement review, and the claim is recommended to
proceed on the current evidence.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
